description: Email normalisation the server applies before digesting an identifier (CR-05). The local part keeps its case and is only NFC-normalised; the domain is lower-cased; no alias is rewritten. normalise lists input and the exact normal form. distinct lists pairs that are different identifiers and must never share a digest. runtime/contracts/the Go contract implementation.normalise_email is the reference and tests/contracts/test_the Go contract implementation.py runs both lists against it; NOR-30 must pass them too. username_match lists username pairs and whether they share a match form (the Go contract implementation.username_match_key: NFC, str.casefold, NFC); the username itself is echoed as received.

normalise.why: no +tag stripping and no provider aliasing
a $ in the local part is kept
the local part is NFC-normalised, nothing else

distinct.why: a +tag is part of the address
dots are part of the address

username_match.why: Unicode default case folding, not lower()
